Maria H: Quick FYI — we need to shuffle the release train for Tue AM. Canary A (payments) is running late, so we should swap the order: infra migrations first, then payments. Can someone volunteer to own the smoke run + rollback for the infra change?
Ajay Patel: I can take infra smoke. ETA: I'll be on call during the 09:00-10:30 window.
Tim O'Neal: I can cover payments smoke after that. Which migrations are we talking about exactly?
Maria H: @Tim O'Neal it's the DB partitioning script and a small redis key schema change. Migration PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/824
Sasha I: Heads-up, the migration touches the consumer reads; recommend a short canary with ~5% traffic, verify tail latency before promoting.
Olivia K: I can help with canary traffic ramp and metric checks. What are the exact smoke steps so I can script them?
Ajay Patel: Smoke checklist (brief):
1) run `infra/migrate v2 --dry-run` on staging
2) deploy migration with `--no-auto-promote`
3) validate consumer 95th p95 < 120ms and error rate < 0.1% for 10m
4) if good, promote; else `infra/rollback v2`
Olivia K: I'll turn that into a tiny runbook and attach to the deploy ticket.
deploy-bot: Reservation confirmed: release-train-slot reserved by Ajay Patel 2026-02-03 09:00 UTC -> 10:30 UTC. Slot ID: rt-20260203-09
Tim O'Neal: For rollback, what's the impact surface? DB partition is reversible but takes ~15m, redis key change requires consumer restart if we revert. We should plan a 30m backout window.
Sasha I: Agreed — call it out on the ticket. Also add a quick smoke query set for payments post-deploy (sample queries included in PR description).
Maria H: Thanks everyone. Final owners: Ajay (infra smoke + rollback), Tim (payments smoke), Olivia (traffic ramp + metrics). Sasha to monitor latency during canary. I'll update the release board and ping infra on-call.
Olivia K: Ping me in the deploy-channel when you start the canary, I'll kick off the scripted checks. :thumbsup:
Ajay Patel: I'll post the after-action notes in the thread once done.
Tim O'Neal: Sounds good — I'll be ready for a 10:15 handover if we need to delay slightly.
Maria H: Perfect. No blockers from me. If anything changes, reply here so we have the audit trail.
Olivia K: attaching runbook: `docs/runbooks/release-train-canary-quick.md` (will copy into ticket).
Maria H: Awesome — thanks team :rocket:
